mechanism: Same-duration q0 amplitude update, shared spectator noise, complete three-bit readout.
analytic_derivation: The q0 Hamiltonian acts on a distinct tensor factor from the q1,q2 Hamiltonian. Initial preparation and all noise channels also factor across this partition.
Changing only q0 amplitude at a common duration leaves the spectator channel Q identical: P_j(X,S)=Bern(x_j) times Q(S).
For all-bit-zero success and s=Q(00), y_j=1-s(1-x_j); hence Delta=s(x_new-x_old). For s>0 the signs agree exactly.
Complete readout supplies X from each paid shot. OR compression discards X whenever S is nonzero. No physical postselection or extra shot is required to retain X.

In the enlarged arbitrary-common-Q model, the likelihood factor involving Q cancels in the sign test, so X counts suffice. This need not be a minimal sufficient statistic for the more restricted physical model with shared nuisance parameters.
A balanced equal-mean null has m=(x_old+x_new)/2, and per-shot KL equals Bernoulli JS. Fisher information for x from OR divided by that from X is s*x/(1-s+s*x).
Delta magnitude can use pooled spectator success: var coefficient 2*s^2*(v(x_old)+v(x_new))+(x_new-x_old)^2*s*(1-s). This is asymptotic, not a finite-sample certificate.

public_fixed_controls.status: Static exploratory design; never generated from a held-out scorer truth.

enlarged_factorized_model_information.model: Independent Bern(x_j) times arbitrary common Q; x_old,x_new,Q unrestricted.
enlarged_factorized_model_information.scope: Necessary expected-shot bounds for paired/balanced tests valid over the enlarged class; not attainable stopping costs, not physical-model universal bounds, not a ratio of optimal costs.

physical_binary_reflection_information.scope: A genuine physical alternative with opposite sign and identical public controls/context. Change-of-measure necessary expected-shot bounds apply to tests with P_accept>=.95 here and <=.01 in the reflected world, stopping only after paid independent old/new pairs. These lower bounds alone do not demonstrate achievable speedup.

unequal_duration_obstruction.meaning: Local q0 improves, but the changed spectator distribution makes the target worse. Common duration/noise is an essential structural assumption.

deterministic_physics_audit.status: Floating gate verification plus exact rational designated instance; analytic factorization proof is stated separately.

required_strong_comparators.name: Safe two-sample Bernoulli e-process on q0
required_strong_comparators.reference: Turner, Ly and Gruenwald; existing safe full-count/KT evidence implementation
required_strong_comparators.requirement: Same complete bitstrings, known common-Q factorization, target context and paid costs; extract X directly.

required_strong_comparators.name: Frozen exact paired-sign mixture on q0
required_strong_comparators.requirement: Fresh independent old/new shots, charge concordant pairs too, use identical risk and power targets.

required_strong_comparators.name: Bernoulli GLR with valid mixture threshold
required_strong_comparators.reference: Kaufmann and Koolen 2021; Track-and-Stop when unequal allocation is allowed
required_strong_comparators.requirement: Prove implemented threshold applies to the composite sign null and permitted allocation; count all learning shots.

required_strong_comparators.name: Physics-aware known-control likelihood/e-process
required_strong_comparators.requirement: May exploit exactly the same public controls, tensor factorization and response relations as FaultTune; unknown physical parameters stay hidden and are inferred from paid outcomes.

fairness_and_limits: The roughly fifty-fold effect is loss from compressing observed bitstrings to OR, not superiority over SOTA methods given the same information.
Any comparator can use X; no claim is made that FaultTune outperforms those comparators.
No free inverse, controlled-U, amplitude amplification, coherent repeat queries, simulator truth, or shared old/new random noise is available.
Every old/new target shot costs one complete circuit run. Both configurations have equal duration, readout/reset cost, context and three-bit measurement.
A full-output theorem does not repair the previously proved wrong-context nonidentifiability: this construction requires target-context shots.
Equal duration is a new frozen control family; prior duration-changing benchmark results remain untouched.
Common-Q factorization is supplied by a declared exact model, not inferred for free. Arm-dependent spectator noise or q0-spectator entangling terms require a new robust certificate.
The designated high-gain instance is exploratory and cannot be repurposed as a held-out SOTA result.
JS and variance ratios are deterministic information diagnostics; they are not measured sample-cost speedups or finite-cap power guarantees.
recommended_next_gate: Only benchmark a new validator after including structure-aware q0 safe/paired/GLR baselines. A result against OR-only validation is an instrumentation benefit. Seek extra measurement or across-update structure if the goal remains >=3x over same-information SOTA.
